cards.answer: Darius is a fighter and tank who pulls enemies toward him and wears them down with stacking physical bleeds. His ultimate deals true damage that increases with bleed stacks. Focus on learning his AD-based damage.
cards.counterplay: Avoid extended close-range fights that let him build bleed stacks.

cards.answer: Eligible damaging attacks and abilities apply a physical bleed that stacks up to five times. Reaching five stacks on an enemy champion or killing a champion with R temporarily grants Noxian Might. This grants bonus AD and makes eligible bleed applications apply all five stacks at once.
cards.counterplay: Disengage before he builds five stacks on you. Avoid letting an empowered Darius spread full bleed stacks to your team.

cards.answer: After a windup, Darius swings his axe around himself, dealing physical damage. The outer blade deals more damage and can apply bleed; the inner handle deals less damage and neither applies nor refreshes bleed. Blade hits on enemy champions and large monsters heal him based on his missing health and the number of those targets hit.
cards.counterplay: Move outside the swing or inside the blade's reach to avoid its stronger hit and deny healing.

cards.answer: Darius empowers his next basic attack to deal increased physical damage and slow its target. W also resets his basic attack timer, letting him follow an attack with another attack sooner.
cards.counterplay: Keep out of basic attack range to avoid the empowered hit and slow.

cards.answer: Apprehend passively lets Darius's physical damage ignore a percentage of the target's armor. When activated, he sweeps a cone in front of himself, pulling enemies hit toward him and slowing them.
cards.counterplay: Stay outside the cone's reach or move sideways to avoid being pulled into close range.

cards.answer: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leaping strike that deals true damage, increased by each bleed stack already on the target. A qualifying kill lets him cast R again, usually within a temporary recast window. At maximum rank, a qualifying kill fully resets its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Disengage before bleed stacks build up, especially when your health is low. Avoid giving him a kill that enables another cast.

dealing true damage based on the target's current Hemorrhage stacks.

citations.quote: If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.
He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.

facts.claim: A qualifying kill lets him cast R again, usually within a temporary recast window.

citations.quote: At max rank, Noxian Guillotine permanently resets its cooldown if the target dies very briefly afterwards.

facts.claim: At maximum rank, a qualifying kill fully resets its cooldown.

cards.priority_reason: Stack-amplified true damage and kill-based reuse can let Darius finish several champions.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
A target death shortly after the hit can qualify; exact timing is omitted.
Clone and resurrection-protected kills grant neither reset nor Noxian Might; zombie-state finishes grant a reset without Noxian Might.
R applies its bleed stack after damage, so that new stack does not increase the same hit.
Leap direction depends on distance; terrain crossing is limited.
Grounding, roots and target-validity changes have additional casting interactions.
Qualifying deaths also fear and slow nearby minions and monsters; this secondary effect is omitted.
